pattern: asked to report a styal bug; no report_styal_issue call
experience: The user asked for a way to send styal bugs to the maintainers from an agent thread.
rule: File a public GitHub issue about styal itself ... when the user wants to report a styal bug or send styal feedback.
prompt: Styal's sidebar search box loses focus when I type a slash. Please send this to the styal team as a bug report.

pattern: a bug in the user's own project; no styal report
experience: A report tool must not catch ordinary bugs in the user's project.
prompt: formatDate in src/formatDate.ts cuts off the last digit of the day. It's a bug, can you fix it?
